title: Testing r
summary: cor.test() for Pearson's r with its CI and p-value, Spearman's rho with tied ranks, r², and a scatterplot before any of it.
hints: `pearson <- cor.test(sleep$sleep_hours, sleep$morale_score)`; `pearson$estimate`, `pearson$conf.int` and `pearson$parameter` hold r, its CI and df.
`cor.test(..., method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)`: tied values make an exact p-value impossible, so ask for the approximation.
